$comment: GEO check (docs/marketing.md): `pnpm geo:check` asks each question through the claude CLI on a Claude subscription and records whether the product is mentioned, how it ranks among the brands named, and whether its domains are cited. `model` is required (no default). `webSearch: true` lets the model search the web, which is closer to AI search engines and slower. Write questions the way a buyer would ask, without the product name.
questions: What is a good project management tool for a small team that wants AI summaries it can review?
Which project tools keep an audit log of every change and every AI call?
What are the best alternatives to Asana for a team of 10 that needs data isolation per client?
